title: A restaurant in Istanbul
assumptions: A new limited company opening a restaurant in Beyoğlu with staff and a fit-out, no alcohol. Each item quotes the ministry or municipality page the registry entry was verified on (read 2026-10-22).

mustNotInclude.name: EU rules
mustNotInclude.why: Türkiye is not in the EU.

items.name: Company registration (MERSİS)
items.quote: Bu sayede, ticaret sicili müdürlükleri şirket kuruluşlarında tek temas noktası haline getirilmiştir.
items.en: This makes the trade registry offices the single point of contact for forming a company.

items.name: Tax registration
items.quote: İşe başlama bildirimi, şirketlerin kuruluş aşamasında işe başlama tarihinden itibaren 10 gün içinde ticaret sicili memurluğunca ilgili vergi dairesine yapılır.
items.en: For a company, the trade registry notifies the tax office of the start of business within 10 days, at formation.

items.name: Employer workplace registration
items.quote: işverenler, örneği Kurumca hazırlanacak işyeri bildirgesini en geç sigortalı çalıştırmaya başladığı tarihte, Kuruma vermekle yükümlü tutulmuşlardır.
items.en: employers must file the workplace registration form, as prepared by the Institution, at the latest on the day they start employing insured workers.

items.name: Food business registration
items.agency: Istanbul Provincial Directorate of Agriculture and Forestry (the district directorate for the address)
items.quote: gıda işletmelerinin kayıt belgesi alma zorunluluğu bulunmaktadır.
items.en: food businesses are obliged to obtain a registration certificate.

items.name: Zoning and fire opinions
items.agency: The district municipality's zoning department and the Istanbul Metropolitan Fire Department
items.quote: İstanbul Büyük Şehir İtfaiye Müdürlüğüne (Yangın, patlama v.b yönünden), Belediye İmar ve Şehircilik Müdürlüğüne (imar yönünden)
items.en: to the Istanbul Metropolitan Fire Department (for fire, explosion and the like), to the municipality's zoning department (for zoning)

items.name: Business opening and operating licence
items.quote: İşyeri Açma ve Çalışma Ruhsatı Müracaatları Gerekli evraklar hazırlandıktan sonra Belediyemiz Ruhsat ve Denetim Müdürlüğüne Şahsen veya şirkette imzaya yetkili kişilerce yapılır.
items.en: Applications for the business opening and operating licence are made to the municipality's licensing department, in person or by the company's signatories.
